method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain
Equities.summary: Companies from Royal Caribbean to Coca-Cola and UPS say they are seeing steady consumer spending despite high inflation.
Equities.reason: Broad earnings signal: multiple large consumer-exposed names reporting resilience reduces recession fear and supports equities/earnings season narrative. High relevance for market regime (consumer demand sustaining S&P earnings momentum).

Equities.title: Nasdaq futures rise as SK Hynix boosts chips before Fed decision, earnings
Equities.reason: Sector-led flow: SK Hynix-driven chip rally is lifting US tech futures ahead of a Fed decision — reinforces AI/hardware leadership as the dominant equity narrative while Fed uncertainty remains the main macro risk.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares jump 11% after record quarterly profit, outperforming broader market
Equities.summary: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared 11% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates.
Equities.reason: Earnings catalyst in a key AI supply chain name — meaningful sector signal that chips/AI demand is tangible. Important for tech leadership but somewhat single-stock/sector specific so relevance trimmed.

Equities.title: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
Equities.summary: Google is opening its TPU business beyond its own cloud as custom chips become a bigger engine for growth.
Equities.reason: Strategic corporate shift that widens AI chip distribution and monetisation — reinforces multi-quarter AI investment cycle and durable leadership of large-cap tech, a high-impact theme for equities.

Equities.title: Global stocks get AI lift ahead of packed 48 hours
Equities.reason: Macro/regime signal: Reuters item captures broad market behaviour — AI-driven risk-on across regions ahead of major data/events. High relevance as it reflects the prevailing cross-market narrative rather than idiosyncratic moves.

Equities.title: From Wall Street to Silicon Valley, Anthropic IPO poised to have massive 'trickle-down effect'
Equities.summary: With the AI trade sputtering of late and interest rates on the rise, Anthropic's IPO is taking on outsized importance.
Equities.reason: Event risk to the dominant AI narrative: a large, high-profile IPO that could disappoint would likely dent AI sentiment and tech multiples amid higher-rate backdrop — a meaningful potential headwind for equities.

Equities.title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms’ shares soar over 21% on trading debut after record IPO
Equities.summary: Jio had offered 270 million shares in the IPO priced at 1,119 rupees apiece, raising 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in the country's largest-ever IPO.
Equities.reason: Major EM equity event: record IPO and big first-day pop supports EM risk appetite and retail flows, a positive micro-to-macro inflow signal but regionally concentrated so moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Investors Brace for Big Tech’s A.I. Spending Bill
Equities.reason: Earnings/earnings-mix risk: heavier near-term AI capex and opex could squeeze margins for big tech despite long-term growth, introducing a moderating force on lofty multiples and tempering the pure risk-on AI narrative.

Rates.title: Treasury yields nudge toward one-week highs; Fed decision, Big Tech earnings loom
Rates.reason: Headline signals U.S. Treasury yields moving higher into a Fed decision — a near-term bond selloff / higher-for-longer narrative. Relevant to rates markets as a market-led move ahead of policy communication; moderate relevance.

Rates.title: BoC expected to raise interest rates to 2.50%
Rates.summary: The Bank of Canada (BoC) is expected to raise its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on Wednesday, as persistent inflation concerns put pressure on policymakers to tighten monetary policy despite growing signs of economic weakness.
Rates.reason: Explicit central-bank hike expectation — negative for Canadian bond prices and consistent with a tighter global rates backdrop. High policy relevance for regional rates pricing.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar outperforms as hot CPI data lifts hawkish RBA expectations
Rates.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades sharply higher against its major currency peers on Wednesday. Against the US Dollar (USD), the antipodean is up 0.15% to near 0.7035 even after giving back some of its early losses.
Rates.reason: Hot CPI lifting hawkish RBA expectations implies higher Australian yields (pressure on bond prices). FX-focused piece but transmits directly into local rates expectations.

Rates.title: Fed Expected to Hold Rates With Nod to December: Decision-Day Guide
Rates.reason: Fed likely to hold today but signal potential December action — supports a higher-for-longer narrative and keeps upward pressure on yields versus a dovish/cut scenario. High relevance around a key policy event.

Rates.title: US-Friendly Nations Slash Treasury Purchases by 60%, Led by Asia
Rates.reason: Large drop in official Treasury demand is a meaningful negative for U.S. bond prices (higher yields) — a material supply/demand shock with broad market implications.

Rates.title: Chinese Government to Speed Bond Sales to Stimulate Growth
Rates.reason: Faster sovereign issuance increases supply and is negative for bond prices (yields up), particularly relevant given scale of China issuance and global portfolio flows.

Rates.title: Asia Rate Calls Are Blindsiding Markets and There’s More to Come
Rates.reason: Reports of surprise/accelerating rate moves in Asia point to a regional tightening surprise that pressures bond prices and can feed global rates repricing — negative for bonds with meaningful regional relevance.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates fell for the second straight week, but more borrowers still sought savings in riskier loans
Rates.summary: Mortgage rates have fallen over the past two weeks, but demand is only slightly higher, and more borrowers are looking for savings in riskier loans.
Rates.reason: Falling U.S. mortgage rates indicate some downward pressure on longer-term yields / mortgage-backed spreads — modestly positive for bond prices, but limited market-moving scope.

FX.title: Euro seems vulnerable near yearly low, Fed-ECB policy is under spotlight

FX.reason: EUR near yearly low and Fed/ECB policy spotlight point to broad USD strength vs EUR. High relevance given major-pair status and dovish/hawkish policy focus driving FX flows.

FX.title: Euro: Fed focus keeps pressure against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that EUR/USD slid to its lowest level since May 2025, but recent Eurozone data and the ECB Bank Lending Survey may be overshadowed by the upcoming Fed decision.
FX.reason: Bank commentary reinforces market narrative that Fed focus (and USD outperformance) is pressuring EUR; meaningful but somewhat redundant with other EUR/Fed stories so moderate relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Lending slowdown threatens key support against US Dollar - ING

FX.reason: ING highlights multiple EUR-specific stresses (energy, French budget) amplifying USD strength — relevant to EUR/USD downside and market positioning.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: DXY sits near two-week top, above 102.00 ahead of FOMC
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, eases from a nearly two-week high, touched earlier this Wednesday, as bulls turn cautious ahead of the crucial FOMC decision.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move: near-term USD strength into the FOMC is a primary FX driver. High relevance because DXY moves transmit across major pairs and set intraday risk backdrop.

FX.reason: Summary piece noting USD consolidation and FOMC risk — broad, timely FX context supporting USD momentum; standard daily relevance.

FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) sells off across the board on Wednesday and dives more than 1.3% against the US Dollar (USD) following the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s (RBNZ) monetary policy decision.
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast piece (limited relevance cap) showing aggressive NZD selloff after RBNZ pause — contributes to USD-strength narrative but treated as lower-relevance technical flow.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ pause signals downside risk against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Norman Liebke notes that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) surprised markets by holding at 2.75%, even as it signalled further hikes will likely be needed.
FX.reason: Macro commentary tying an RBNZ hold to NZD downside and USD strength; significant for NZD flows and regional FX volatility around global rate news.

FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes the US Dollar (USD) is under upward pressure ahead of the FOMC, with NZD/USD hit hard after a surprise Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) hold. He expects the FOMC to keep rates on hold but maintain a hawkish tone, with December lar
FX.reason: Counter-signal: MUFG highlights that a dovish Fed surprise could reverse USD gains. Included at lower relevance as it's conditional and markets are pricing a hawkish tilt.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Upside limited against US Dollar ahead of BoC decision - MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny sees an 80% implied probability of a BoC hike but doubts Governor Macklem will validate the 100 bps of tightening priced through next September. With weak Canadian labour data and lingering US trade risks, he sees little room for front-en
FX.reason: BoC-hike pricing vs US developments implies limited CAD upside and relative USD strength; relevant because CAD is commodity/FX sensitive around central-bank decisions.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Moves above 1.4050 to target moving averages
FX.summary: USD/CAD gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.4060 during European hours on Wednesday. The Bank of Canada (BoC) is expected to deliver a 25-basis-point interest rate hike later in the day.
FX.reason: Technical forecast on USD/CAD (price-forecast cap on relevance). Reinforces USD strength narrative ahead of BoC decision but treated as lower-relevance technical flow.

FX.title: British Pound trims losses but remains below 1.3300 with all eyes on the UK budget
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) is heading south against the US Dollar (USD) for the fourth consecutive day on Wednesday, with investors awaiting the release of the UK budget and the US Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy decision, both due later in the day.
FX.reason: GBP under pressure into UK budget and FOMC — contributes to overall USD-strong / G10-weak narrative; material for GBP/USD positioning.

FX.title: British Pound: Neutral budget, higher BoE rates ahead – ABN AMRO
FX.summary: ABN AMRO economists Bill Diviney and Adrian Quinn expect the United Kingdom (UK) to maintain its fiscal consolidation progress, supported by resilient economic growth.
FX.reason: ABN AMRO expects fiscal consolidation and higher BoE rates — a modest GBP-supporting theme that offsets some USD-strength risk; included at low relevance as it is anticipatory.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Further weakness seen against US Dollar - UOB

FX.title: Indian Rupee weakens due to higher oil prices ahead of Fed's policy
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) gives back its opening gains and turns negative against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday.
FX.reason: INR weakness tied to oil and Fed headlines — relevant for EMFX flows but lower impact on majors; scored modestly negative for USD strength vs INR.

FX.title: Euro edges up from yearly lows as British Pound softens awaiting UK budget

FX.reason: Minor intraday EUR bounce driven by GBP moves — small counter-signal to the dominant USD-strength narrative, low relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold slips on oil-fuelled inflation fears ahead of Fed meeting
Commodities.reason: Major Reuters note tying oil-driven inflation fears and an upcoming Fed decision to gold pressure. Higher inflation/yields and Fed tightening expectations are negative for bullion; Reuters + Fed timing makes this a key near-term driver.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles to gain traction ahead of Fed policy verdict
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) stalls its rebound on Wednesday as investors await the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement, due at 18:00 GMT. A modest pullback in Oil prices helped bullion recover from its lowest levels since July over the past two days.
Commodities.reason: Confirms the Reuters-led narrative: Fed event pressure on gold with only modest oil-led support. Short-term market technicals and event risk keep relevance moderate but smaller than primary Reuters piece.

Commodities.title: JPMorgan Private Bank’s Tang Sees More Downside Risk for Gold
Commodities.reason: Large-bank strategist warning reinforces bearish positioning and adds to selling pressure on gold; notable institutional view increases relevance versus retail/technical pieces.

Commodities.title: India Jewelers Hold Off Gold Buying, Betting Prices Will Drop
Commodities.reason: Physical demand slowdown in a major market (India) is a fundamental negative for gold price support and reinforces the downbeat supply/demand backdrop.

Commodities.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD recovery halts below previous support around $4,070
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) shows moderate losses on Wednesday, trading at the $4,.050 area as the previous two days’ recovery was capped at a support-turned-resistance, around $4,070.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece — limited relevance by the scoring rules but consistent with the broader near-term bearish tone around XAU/USD.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $54.04 per troy ounce, down 0.71% from the $54.42 it cost on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Silver acting as a follower to gold weakness; small intraday move with limited standalone relevance but aligns with the broader precious-metals soft tone.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Weather-driven production shut-ins in the Gulf are a classic short-term bullish catalyst for energy (WTI/natgas). Single-source EIA bulletin raises regional supply risk and supports oil prices.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs above $81,000 as majors rally ahead of Fed decision
Crypto.reason: Market-moving price action: BTC breaking above $81k ahead of a Fed decision signals macro-driven risk-on flows and liquidity tailwinds for crypto — a near-term positive for market sentiment and flows.

Crypto.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
Crypto.reason: Big-tech custody/security development: Google previewing custody security addresses a core institutional hurdle (custody/operational risk), supporting institutional adoption and reducing security friction.

Crypto.title: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain as institutional tokenization gathers steam
Crypto.reason: Tokenization adoption: Securitize expanding to Stellar is another incremental sign that institutional tokenization infrastructure is broadening, supporting structural demand for on-chain assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
Crypto.reason: Severe custody/access failure at a bitcoin treasury: an inability to access BTC is highly negative for trust and could amplify counterparty/custody risk concerns across institutional and retail holders.

Crypto.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
Crypto.reason: Pro-crypto policy signal: a senior Treasury official framing crypto as a tool for U.S. dollar competitiveness is a supportive regulatory/strategic narrative that can underpin institutional confidence and long-term adoption.

Crypto.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
Crypto.reason: Hardware-wallet security breach: large-scale device destruction after a breach reinforces security fragility and could weigh on retail trust and on-ramps.

Crypto.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
Crypto.reason: Exchange/operational security incident: another exchange-related hack increases sector-wide cyber risk perceptions, negative for confidence in centralized venue custody and flows.

Crypto.title: Coinbase says user funds are safe after third-party vendor exposes customer contact info
Crypto.reason: Privacy/security vendor exposure with funds reportedly safe: modest negative on reputational/privacy fronts but limited direct contagion to asset safety.

Crypto.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
Crypto.reason: Strong corporate adoption signal: widespread tokenized cash uptake by large corporates points to material real-economy utility and demand for on-chain settlement solutions.

Crypto.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/market infrastructure development in EM: a major bank formalizing crypto brokerage under new rules signals regulatory acceptance and broadens institutional access in a large market.

Crypto.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts
Crypto.reason: Weak retail trading revenue: materially lower crypto revenue at a major retail platform suggests softer retail volumes/liquidity, a headwind for short-term market depth.

Crypto.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin distribution/adoption: arrival of RLUSD on a large retail platform expands stablecoin choice/liquidity and signals commercial stablecoin competition and integration.

Crypto.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
Crypto.reason: Onchain institutional pricing infrastructure: porting Wall Street benchmarks onchain (used by big asset managers) materially lowers frictions for institutional issuance, trading and risk management.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
Crypto.reason: Miners diversifying into AI compute markets: provides potential new revenue streams for miners, improving their economics and reducing pure BTC-price sensitivity.
